analysis.paired_changes: For each contrast: pixel-thinned contrast minus corresponding full-label CUDA90 contrast, paired by source/selection/initialization and panel region.
inference_limits: No new confirmatory test, equivalence margin or independent holdout.
Available processed unique-label pixels matched; crop visits, native annotation area, human effort/time and class composition unmatched.
No mediation fraction or significance inference from two intervals signs/overlap.
